structure.unit: Other Regulated Providers of Financial Services

text.section:
A licensee shall file a report with the Commission within three business days after the licensee has reason to know of the occurrence of any of the following events:
An indictment, charge, or conviction of the licensee or of a key individual or person in control of the licensee for a felony;
An indictment, charge, or conviction of an authorized delegate for a felony; or
Such other events as the Commission may prescribe by regulation.
